===Etymology===
From {{der|zh|sit-pro|*gaŋ||penis, male}} (STEDT).

{{zh-ref| Schuessler, (2007)}} minimally reconstructs OC *'''kâŋ''' from earlier *'''klaŋ''' and proposed OC word's cognacy to {{cog|mro|klaŋ}}, {{cog|lus|tlaŋ||male}}, {{cog|mjw|chè '''lóŋ'''||buffalo}}, and {{cog|bo|གླང||ox}}, the latter four from {{cog|tbq-pro|*laŋ}} with animal prefix *'''s-''' or *'''k-'''; if so, from {{der|zh|sit-pro|*b/m-laŋ||penis, male, husband}} (STEDT).

{{zh-ref|Gong (1995)}} instead relates {{cog|bo|གླང||ox}} to Old Chinese {{och-l|象}}  "elephant".

Zev Handel also notes {{och-l|犅}}'s parallel etymology with its homophone {{och-l|岡}} "ridge" (Mand. '''gāng''') in the same phonetic series.
